title: Operate radiocommunications devices only under a licence
what: Operating a radiocommunications device needs an apparatus, spectrum or class licence.

sources.title: Radiocommunications Act 1992
sources.quote: 46 Unlicensed operation of radiocommunications devices Offence (1) Subject to section 49, a person must not operate a radiocommunications device otherwise than as authorised by: (a) a spectrum licence; or (b) an apparatus licence; or (c) a class licence

assessment.summary: Operating a radiocommunications device needs an apparatus, spectrum or class licence.

marks.reason: Apparatus or spectrum licences are needed before transmitting.
Scarce spectrum licences limit how many operators can compete.
